name: Exemplar
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Moderate Perception; high Religion; high Str or Dex; moderate AC; moderate Fortitude, low Reflex, high Will; high HP; high accuracy and high damage. Abilities: Weapon Ikon appropriate for weapon used, a Body Ikon or Worn Ikon of choice, Reactive Strike, Ikon abilities from chosen Ikons and feats related to chosen Ikons

notes.defense: Moderate AC; moderate Fortitude, low Reflex, high Will; high HP.
notes.offense: High attack bonus and high damage.
notes.specials: A weapon ikon that suits the weapon it uses, a body ikon or worn ikon of choice, Reactive Strike, the chosen ikons' abilities and feats related to them.
